axes.rationale: Bounded 2x2 signedness test; target's outer comparison uses signed JL, so signed versus unsigned band changes branch lowering while preserving loop bounds/increments.

axes.name: cell_type
axes.rationale: Bounded 2x2 signedness test; target's inner comparison uses signed JL, so signed versus unsigned cell changes branch lowering while preserving loop bounds/increments.

spec.semantic_summary: Isolated flat-owner source probe from production attempt01: change the Dx8-based BN accesses to named far PherMapBN[band + cell], then test only int/unsigned int signedness for band and cell.
binding_evidence: Target packet ColonySmellBN-90c93a3ed6 loads the selector for segment 8 once, sets DS from AX, and addresses bytes at 0x62d2 + band + cell; the owner identity is _PherMapBN at segment 8, offset 0x62d2.
All other loop/control and declaration-order source is copied from preserved attempt01; prior 2D named-far experiment is a separate tested representation.
